name: streamos-app
description: Remote-first streaming interface for Android TV and Fire TV

scripts.test: npm run check:js && npm run test:navigation && npm run test:update && npm run test:intro-markers && npm run test:server && npm run test:android
scripts.check:js: node --check www/js/api.js && node --check www/js/app.js && node --check www/js/grid-navigation.js && node --check www/js/navigation.js && node --check www/js/player.js && node --check www/js/router.js && node --check www/js/ui.js && node --check www/js/update-policy.js && node --check www/server/intro-markers.js && node --check www/server/index.js
scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare:android && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
